description: This file is a shell script containing automated tests for a Git-P4 integration workflow. It defines various test scenarios for client views, file mappings, wildcard handling, overlay configurations, and directory renames within a Perforce and Git environment. The script uses functions like `client_view`, `client_verify`, and `git p4 clone` to set up and verify version control states, including complex overlay and wildcard scenarios.

methods.name: check_files_exist
methods.description: Verifies that specified files exist in the current directory and that the total count of files matches expectations.

methods.name: client_view
methods.description: Sets up or verifies the client view mappings for the depot and client workspace.

methods.name: client_verify
methods.description: Confirms that specific files exist in the client workspace, matching the expected set.

methods.name: git_verify
methods.description: Checks the presence of files tracked in the Git workspace, ensuring consistency with expected files.
